extractions.justification: We have carefully analyzed each expression. 'natural language processing' isn't an acronym but a full term, as is 'controllable text generation'. 'ctg' clearly stands for 'controllable text generation', and 'qg' corresponds to 'question generation'. Similarly, 'question generation' itself is an explanatory phrase, not an abbreviation. Terms like 'prompt engineering' and 'prompting are descriptive but don't involve acronyms.
